description: Summary figure: GT6 functional residue audit, dN/dS selection test, and signal anchor hydropathy
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
T=pd.read_csv("GT6_functional_residue_audit.csv")
res=pd.read_csv("dnds_nei_gojobori.csv")
seqs=json.load(open("gt6_panel.json"))["seqs"]

orth_cols=["RAT","MOUSE","CHIMP","MACAQUE","MARMOSET","DOG","CAT","HORSE","CAMEL","NMRAT","GPIG"]
M=np.zeros((len(T),len(orth_cols)))
for i,row in T.iterrows():
    hres=str(row["HUMAN_A3GALT2"])[0]
    for j,c in enumerate(orth_cols):
        v=str(row[c])
        M[i,j]= 0 if (v!="gap" and v[0]==hres) else 1

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,9.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1.35,1],hspace=0.38,wspace=0.26)

# A: residue conservation matrix
axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
axA.imshow(M.T,aspect="auto",cmap=plt.matplotlib.colors.ListedColormap(["#1a7f5a","#d1495b"]),vmin=0,vmax=1)
axA.set_xticks(range(len(T)))
axA.set_xticklabels([f"{T.bov_site[i]}\n{T.HUMAN_A3GALT2[i]}" for i in range(len(T))],fontsize=8.5)
axA.set_yticks(range(len(orth_cols))); axA.set_yticklabels(orth_cols,fontsize=9)
axA.set_xlabel("bovine GGTA1 functional residue (top) mapped to human A3GALT2 position (bottom)",fontsize=9.5)
for i in range(len(T)):
    for j in range(len(orth_cols)):
        if M[i,j]: axA.text(i,j,str(T[orth_cols[j]][i])[0],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7.5,color="w")
axA.set_xticks(np.arange(-.5,len(T),1),minor=True); axA.set_yticks(np.arange(-.5,len(orth_cols),1),minor=True)
axA.grid(which="minor",color="w",lw=1.1); axA.tick_params(which="minor",length=0)
axA.set_title("A. Human A3GALT2 matches every mutagenesis-validated GT6 functional residue except one\n"
              "green = ortholog residue identical to human, red = differs",fontsize=11,loc="left")
for lbl,x in [("DVD motif",1.0),("catalytic Glu",10.0),("C-term UDP loop",14.0)]:
    axA.annotate(lbl,xy=(x,-0.75),ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#2d6cdf",annotation_clip=False)

# B: dN/dS
axB=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
order=["homo-pan_","homo-maca","homo-call","maca-call","mus_-ratt","homo-mus_","maca-mus_"]
lab={"homo-pan_":"human vs chimp","homo-maca":"human vs macaque","homo-call":"human vs marmoset",
     "maca-call":"macaque vs marmoset","mus_-ratt":"mouse vs rat","homo-mus_":"human vs mouse","maca-mus_":"macaque vs mouse"}
w=0.38; x=np.arange(len(order))
a3=[res[(res.gene=="A3GALT2")&(res.pair==p)].omega.values[0] for p in order]
a4=[res[(res.gene=="A4GALT")&(res.pair==p)].omega.values[0] for p in order]
axB.bar(x-w/2,a3,w,label="A3GALT2",color="#2d6cdf")
axB.bar(x+w/2,a4,w,label="A4GALT (control GT)",color="#9aa6b8")
axB.axhline(1.0,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); axB.text(0.05,1.03,"neutral expectation, omega = 1",fontsize=8)
axB.set_xticks(x); axB.set_xticklabels([lab[p] for p in order],rotation=35,ha="right",fontsize=8.5)
axB.set_ylabel("dN/dS (Nei-Gojobori, JC corrected)"); axB.legend(fontsize=8.5)
axB.set_title("B. A3GALT2 is under purifying selection in the primate lineage,\nwith no human-specific elevation",fontsize=11,loc="left")
for xi,v in zip(x-w/2,a3): axB.text(xi,v+0.03,f"{v:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=7.5)

# C: hydropathy
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
def kd(s,w=19):
    v=[KD.get(c,0) for c in s]; return np.array([np.mean(v[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1]) for i in range(len(v))])
axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
for nm,c,ls in [("A3GALT2_HUMAN","#2d6cdf","-"),("A3GALT2_RAT","#d1495b","-"),("GGTA1_BOVIN","#1a7f5a","--")]:
    s=seqs[nm]; axC.plot(range(1,len(s)+1),kd(s),color=c,ls=ls,lw=1.6,label=nm)
axC.axhspan(1.6,5,color="#ffd9a0",alpha=.45)
axC.axvspan(13,32,color="orange",alpha=.2)
axC.set_xlim(0,70); axC.set_ylim(-3,4)
axC.set_xlabel("residue"); axC.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy (window 19)")
axC.legend(fontsize=8)
axC.set_title("C. Type-II signal anchor intact in human A3GALT2\norange band = UniProt transmembrane 13-32",fontsize=11,loc="left")
plt.show()
